name: freya-1-comp (example - copy this file before editing)
description: The Linux main computer. Fill in the USB serial number from the B0 inventory before the first real run; the values below are placeholders and the framework will refuse to open a device it cannot identify.
notes: gear_ratio_servo_to_carousel is ASSUMED to be 1.0 and is one of the things H-002 exists to settle: if the mechanism has a reduction between the ST3215 output shaft and the carousel plate, every angle in the firmware is wrong by that ratio. Do not change it to make a test pass - change it only from a measurement, and set provenance to MEASURED with the run id in notes when you do. slot_count is null so the production value (4) is used; do not put a second copy of it here.
